title: Serialize peer-channel integration tests within one process
goal: Prevent the peer-channel integration tests from racing their four reserved port blocks when libtest runs them concurrently in one binary.

results.isolation: process-local mutex serializes both tests before port-block allocation
results.join_under_load: fixture returns after local sealed admission; callers retain explicit hub-roster assertions instead of waiting on the optional follow-up acknowledgement
results.cli_io: run_cli drains stdout and stderr concurrently so a busy child cannot deadlock on a full pipe
results.status_retry: the first topology test retries peers status through transient sealed HTTP truncation and still requires every requested row to be error-free within the bounded window
